The image shows a soybean plant pulled from the soil. The most prominent symptoms are on the leaves, which are yellowing (chlorotic), and the plant appears stunted compared to the surrounding healthy green plants. The root system is also visible. The foliar symptoms of yellowing and stunting are key indicators. Reviewing the knowledge base, Soybean Cyst Nematode is described as causing "Stunting and chlorosis of leaves... 'Yellow dwarf' is an appropriate description for symptoms commonly caused by SCN." While other diseases can cause yellowing, SCN is a strong candidate when combined with stunting in a field setting. The description also notes that significant yield loss can occur without obvious aboveground symptoms, but when they do appear, they manifest as seen in the image.
